scope: M101 B02 Units4–7; detailed U07 completion and cross-unit progression review, not retrospective rewriting of published Units4–6.
basis: Approved block/unit/lesson blueprints, actual U04/U05/U06 reference statements and adjoining teaching, prior U06 whole-unit review and actual U07 teaching/closing resources. Existing historical review records remain unchanged.
purpose: Change and local behaviour: derivatives developed from limits, then used to reason about functions and local models with checked numerical evidence.

unitChain.role: Domain/composition -> finite and one-sided limits -> continuity and numerical evidence.
unitChain.retrievedInU07: Excluded-point example7.8 and mixed7.16; domain-based stencil selection; exact versus rounded expression distinction.

unitChain.role: Derivative definition -> elementary families/rules -> implicit/second derivatives -> independent checks.
unitChain.retrievedInU07: Local remainder argument, rule-based benchmarks, tangent units, two-sided existence. Prior full differentiation practice is not replaced by the short checkpoint.

unitChain.role: Signs, concavity, extrema/endpoints, related rates, MVT and graph audit.
unitChain.retrievedInU07: Corner critical/nonstationary distinction; mixed7.17 ties/endpoints/inflection; mixed7.18 chain rule, rate units, theorem hypotheses and attained versus limiting value.

unitChain.role: Local prediction -> finite differences -> truncation/finite representation -> synthesis and iCMA02.
unitChain.handover: B03 accumulation; M102 systematic series; A101 transparent approximation checks.

budget: 16+24+18+14=72h;1+2+2+3=8Python hours inside those72. TMA02 remains separately budgeted6h. No credit, calendar, enrolment, submission or completion change.

outcomes.M101-O1: Definition/rules inU05; applications/conditions inU06; local models and derivative-existence safeguards inU07.
outcomes.M101-O5: Progression from nearby function values through derivative/plot checks to independently explainable finite-difference functions and controlled step-size experiments.
outcomes.M101-O6: Domains, signs, units, hypotheses, exact versus empirical claims and readable justified reports throughout.

balance: Abstract polynomial/reciprocal/root/logarithm practice remains substantial alongside supplied sensor, temperature and position contexts. Physics assumptions are supplied; M101 does not claim to teach P101 laws. U07 error bounds are elementary endpoint-error algebra, not a full uncertainty or numerical-analysis course.
assessmentReadiness: The teaching now offers practice for every declared TMA02 role: differentiation, interpretation, local approximation and an explained independent numerical check. Embedded iCMA02 is formative and tests a sample, not exhaustive coverage or mastery. TMA02 questions, rubric and private marking guide are a distinct future commission; this release does not imply that they exist.
stageAndDegree: P101 functions/loops/lists are required before U07 computing; plotting is not required here. P101 calculus applications depend on demonstrated U05 capability, not necessarily completion of all B02. B03 can now build on rates/domains/limits and numerical caution. M102 owns systematic series, deeper analysis and later linear algebra. M201 retains multivariable calculus. No claim to resolve wider degree coverage gaps.
forwardActions: When commissioning TMA02, include independent written and executable evidence plus private checked marking guidance; avoid merely repeating checkpoint questions.
U08 should retrieve signed local rates, continuity and limits while explicitly teaching accumulation and both directions of the fundamental theorem.
Later numerical integration should revisit misleading refinement and independent benchmarks without assuming finite differences certify general convergence.
disposition: Block teaching complete and coherent within approved scope; U07 local checks passed. Assessment availability remains honestly separate. This review establishes content readiness, not learner attainment or external accreditation.
